definitions.explanation: A curved-blade cutting tool used for harvesting crops, cutting grass, and other agricultural work. A fundamental farming implement in traditional Japanese agriculture.

examples.english: To cut grass with a sickle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鎌|かま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刈|か}り{取|と}る→刈り取る：21025_karitoru⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重労働|じゅうろうどう}→重労働：18882_juuroudou⟧だ。
examples.english: Harvesting rice with a sickle is heavy labor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物置|ものおき}→物置：17243_monooki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{鎌|かま}や⟦{鍬|くわ}→鍬：08280_kuwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: In my grandfather's storage shed, old sickles and hoes still remain.

notes:
USAGE:
{鎌|かま} is a traditional farming tool still used in home gardens and small-scale agriculture. It also appears in many idiomatic expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎌|かま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ (to cut/harvest with a sickle)
- ⟦{草刈|くさか}り→草刈り：22813_kusakari⟧{鎌|がま} (grass-cutting sickle)
- {鎌|かま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to try to trick someone into revealing something — an idiomatic expression)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧ (Kamakura) contains this character. Other farming tools include ⟦{鍬|くわ}→鍬：08280_kuwa⟧ (hoe) and ⟦{鋤|すき}→鋤：27971_suki⟧ (plow).

WATCH OUT:
{鎌|かま} (sickle) uses a different kanji from ⟦{窯|かま}→窯：13764_kama⟧ (kiln) and ⟦{釜|かま}→釜：03880_kama⟧ (cooking pot/kettle), though all three are read かま.
